_comment: Symbols excluded from the daily OHLCV staleness alert (check_missed_runs.py) because they're confirmed halted exchange-side, not a pipeline problem. Re-verified monthly by .github/scripts/check_halted_symbols.py (cron in .github/workflows/monthly_halted_symbol_check.yml) via Binance's live exchangeInfo endpoint -- a symbol is dropped from this file automatically the moment its status is no longer BREAK, and normal staleness alerting resumes for it from that point on. Do not edit last_verified/last_verified_status by hand; the monthly job owns those fields.

TON_USDT.reason: status=BREAK (exchange-side trading halt) on Binance Spot, confirmed via GET api.binance.com/api/v3/exchangeInfo?symbol=TONUSDT
